verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page lists a Free plan at $0/month with 250 searches per month, which directly supports prototyping. Cached searches (1h) are also free and don't count toward the monthly quota, which stretches the free allowance during development. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the free tier, and documentation of free-plan scope (which APIs or features are included, signup requirements such as a credit card).
